d1-replaycapsule.text: A capsule holds the rejected transaction, every output it spends or references, the node's parameters and time translation, and the failing hashes, captured before the next submission and bound by a content hash.

d2-tracedprovenance-m1-output-read-by-m3.text: The traced build records its source, compiler, flags and the untraced hashes of the same toolchain, which must equal the deployed blueprint's.

d3-purposereplay.text: One failing purpose: the deployed and traced hashes and two runs.

d4-replayrun.text: A run records the bytes, the budget and the outcome. The deployed run keeps the declared budget; the traced run gets the protocol maximum.

d5-replayclass.text: A reason is admitted only when the deployed bytes fail as a validator and the traced bytes fail with exactly one user trace; otherwise the class names one distinct cause, including phase one, setup failure, timeout and client exception, and it separates a script with no replay route, a replayed script whose parameters do not reproduce the hash, and a script no family explains.

d6-reasoncomparison.text: A step agrees only on equal reasons. The index entry is written before the runner acts, so a differing step fails its row and still leaves its evidence, and an unobserved step keeps its row, writes its receipt without a reason and names its cause.

receipt-placement-q-001.text: Either the receipt keeps its wire and the traced hash lives in replay files joined by transaction id, or one optional replay object is added. The ruling decides.
